done_when: When a three-rounds stop gets no answer in 30 minutes, Forge records the repo's default choice (narrow to the Done-when lines and file each open finding as a follow-up fix, set once in forge.toml and on by default for new and upgraded repos), carries on, and the owner can reverse it later

findings.body: Raise: Functional. The default-choice note reaches the worker only while `worker_round` equals the current round. After that worker runs, the round increments. If the next review is still blocked, a subsequent worker receives the open findings without the narrowing instruction and can resume fixing work that was assigned to follow-up fixes. The land proof uses a clean review immediately after the first worker round, so it does not cover this normal continuation.
findings.title: Narrowing instruction expires after one worker round

findings.body: Raise: Not done. The default creates a fix branch for each open finding at close.py:393, but an owner's later `--resolve accept` changes only the stop and review records here. Those fix branches remain open even though the owner has accepted the findings. The reversal test reaches ready without checking the follow-up fixes, so it misses this lasting effect of the default choice.
findings.title: Reversing the default leaves its follow-up fixes active

findings.body: Raise: Gate. The supplied proof list names only `test_5_owner_choice_after_the_default_reaches_the_worker`. It omits the named proofs for the 30-minute default and filing every open finding (`test_1`), unattended land continuation (`test_3`), and new and previously adopted client repos (`test_4`). Those tests exist, but the latest commit's proof list does not cover these Done-when details.
findings.title: Not done: proof list

stop.reason: Coordinator decision under the owner's low-risk rule (Harm 2, reversible): one more round to make an owner's later choice after a recorded default reach the worker; no other change

why: A three-rounds stop waits for the owner overnight, 6 to 8 hours each time, while nothing moves
